title: A-DO Manga to End on November 18
content: The November issue of Kodansha 's Monthly Young Magazine announced on Tuesday that Jaku Amano 's A-DO manga will end in its next chapter in the magazine's next issue on November 18. The series entered a hiatus in October due to the author's poor physical health, but resumed on February 19.
author: ANN
